item.title: She won big at Sun City — then lost her family, fortune and herself
item.description: From a life-changing R30,000 win to sleeping in petrol stations. Sibongile Nkabinde's story shows how a gambling addiction can destroy a family and a life.

item.title: Welcoming new life: 32 newborns arrive in Western Cape on Christmas Day
item.description: The first baby born on Christmas Day was a little girl at Helderberg Hospital to mother Zizibele Silo.

item.title: Cape Town's law enforcement tackles beach incidents and DUI arrests this Christmas Day
item.description: City of Cape Town safety and law enforcement teams were deployed across beaches and major routes on Christmas Day following a fatal incident at Strandfontein Beach, a near-drowning at Muizenberg Beach, and several alcohol-related enforcement actions.

item.title: Moving beyond festive crackdowns to make road safety an everyday commitment
item.description: The underlying issue is simple: alcohol consumption in South Africa doesn’t pause for eleven months of the year.

item.title: Christmas babies: KZN Health MEC raises alarm over child and teen pregnancies
item.description: KZN Health MEC Nomagugu Simelane visited hospitals on Christmas Day to welcome babies and to thank healthcare staff. She raised alarm about the number of young mothers.

item.title: Heroic rescue: Dog saved from distress in Hermanus Harbour
item.description: NSRI Hermanus crew rescued a hypothermic dog from the rocks at Hermanus New Harbour on Christmas Day, with the animal now recovering after receiving veterinary care as efforts continue to trace its owner.

item.title: What caused the fatal Limpopo crash of a Delta bus heading to Zimbabwe on Christmas Day?
item.description: Wreckage from the fatal Christmas Day head-on collision on the N1-29 near Musekene in Limpopo, involving a Delta passenger bus and an Isuzu heavy motor vehicle. Two drivers were killed in the crash, which the Limpopo Department of Transport and Community Safety said was probably caused by reckless and negligent driving.

item.title: Nina Schumann: A musician's journey through Parkinson’s and the power of expression
item.description: A celebrated pianist finds freedom and expression beyond the concert hall, moving with confidence and joy as she continues to reimagine life and music while living with Parkinson’s.

item.title: The rising cost of deportation: South Africa's R80 million expenditure on undocumented immigrants
item.description: Two Zimbabwean border jumpers drag themselves under one of the fences that separates the two countries.

item.title: Trump orders ‘Deadly’ US strikes on ISIS in Nigeria
item.description: US forces carried out air strikes against Islamic State militants in northwestern Nigeria, killing several fighters in an operation requested by Nigerian authorities, US and Nigerian officials confirmed.
